purpose: Independent hydrologic-state product QA and descriptive parent-state compatibility audit.

authorized_products.SMAP: availability and access audit only unless a complete reproducible local subset is acquired

development_state_period: 2010-2018; 2006-2009 used only for spin-up and anomaly reference
selection_role: none; no candidate fitting, early stopping, selection or promotion
forbidden: reopening Stage 19 after the registered Stage 16 temporal high-flow failure
treating PML or GRACE as direct observations of HBV response components
claiming real fast water, slow water, groundwater, old water or water age
